## Release Drafter category

<!--
Select exactly one primary category. This tells maintainers which GitHub label
to apply before merging so the PR appears in the correct release-notes section.

Contributors do not need permission to manage labels: choose a category here,
and a maintainer will apply or verify the label shown in backticks.

Accessibility may be added as an additional label, but an accessibility feature
should normally select the Enhancement category below for the release notes.
-->

- [ ] Enhancement or new feature — `enhancement`
- [ ] Bug fix — `bug`
- [ ] Documentation only — `documentation`
- [ ] Dependency update — `dependencies`
- [ ] GitHub Actions or CI maintenance — `github_actions`
- [ ] Release preparation or version-only change — `version_bump`
- [ ] No release note needed / maintainer decision required
